chunks: Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah said, and in the narration of Abdullah ibn Sayabah and Ibn Ismail from Najih from one of the Imams (peace be upon him) who said:

When you pray on Friday, say: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, the successors who are pleased, with the best of Your blessings, and bestow blessings upon them with the best of Your blessings, and peace be upon him and upon them and upon their souls and bodies, and the mercy of Allah and His blessings. Allah will write for you a hundred thousand good deeds, erase from you a hundred thousand bad deeds, fulfill for you a hundred thousand needs, and raise for you a hundred thousand degrees.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended supplication and its rewards after Friday prayer according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq, this hadith emphasizes the unique status of the Ahl al-Bayt as 'Al-Muradiyyin' (the pleased ones) within the Friday prayer ritual, linking the recitation of Salawaat directly to immense spiritual accounting. It highlights the Shia belief in the intercessory and merit-generating power of invoking blessings upon the Prophet and his twelve successors, promising a comprehensive spiritual reset of 100,000 good deeds, sins, needs, and ranks. This practice underscores the continuity of prophetic authority and the theological importance of the Imams in the daily worship of the faithful.
